title: Connect to Persona
how_to_pair: On the hub machine, run {command} and paste the whole {link} link it prints here. You can also paste the token printed with {legacy}, or the output of {jq}.
phone_hint: On your phone, scan the QR code the same command prints.
credential_note: This browser gets its own credentials. You can revoke them anytime in Settings › Devices on your phone.
